retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist, earthy composition featuring centered, informal hand-lettering on raw brown kraft paper with a small decorative seal in the lower corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered line of informal, slightly cursive black ink handwriting set against a textured, fibrous brown kraft paper background, anchored by a small circular red graphic in the bottom-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Text centered horizontally and vertically to create a focal point
High contrast between black ink and tan paper substrate
Asymmetrical balance provided by the small red seal in the lower-left corner
Tactile relationship between the fibrous paper grain and the bleeding ink edges
coreInvariants: Raw kraft paper texture with visible fibers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary text is centered, occupying approximately 40% of the horizontal width; secondary seal is small, placed in the lower-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The centered handwritten text acts as the primary anchor, while the red circle provides a secondary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central text, moves downward and left to the red seal, then rests on the overall paper texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space (approximately 85%) emphasizes the raw material of the paper.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a mid-value background and high-value contrast in the ink.

letterConstructionRules: Varying x-heights for a casual feel
Connected lowercase letters with occasional breaks
Felt-tip pen aesthetic with slight ink bleed into paper fibers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'f' with an elongated, sweeping descender
Lowercase 't' with a high, simple crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style focus; contrast is achieved through the graphic seal rather than a second font.
graphicDevices: Circular seal with internal organic line art

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, personal tone of the original lettering.
Provides a similar balance of structure and informality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of brown kraft paper with visible wood fibers and a slightly uneven, matte surface. Place a small, dark red circular stamp in the bottom-left corner containing a simple, gold-colored organic floral line drawing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, black ink hand-lettering in a casual, slightly messy felt-tip style. Ensure the ink looks absorbed into the paper fibers.

verificationChecks: Does the paper have a fibrous, non-uniform texture?
Is the red seal placed in the lower-left quadrant?
Does the lettering look hand-drawn rather than digitally typed?

adjustableVariables: Paper color (light tan to dark brown)
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic paper fiber detail
Verify the 'hand-drawn' quality of the text strokes
Ensure the red seal does not dominate the composition
Confirm the background is a single, cohesive material
recipe.reuseFormula: Informal black ink lettering + centered layout + kraft paper substrate + corner accent seal = Rustic Minimalist Aesthetic.
